meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 用代码把实验室的样品、库存和实验记录接入平台并自动同步
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每天要在实验室平台里手动录入或同步大量样品与实验数据。
copy.tagline_en: Wire lab samples, inventory, and experiment records into your platform with code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually enter or sync lots of lab sample and experiment data.

howto.what: 让 Claude 用 Benchling Python SDK 和 v2 API 写代码:创建和更新 DNA/RNA/蛋白等注册实体、库存容器与位置、实验记录条目、工作流任务,并查询 Data Warehouse。
howto.when: 当你提到 benchling-sdk、v2 API,或要求自动化实验室数据操作时接管。需自备 Benchling 账号、租户 URL,以及 API key 或 OAuth 凭据。

say.text: 查一下 Data Warehouse 里最近的库存变化并汇总。

howto.what_en: Lets Claude write Benchling Python SDK and v2 API code: create and update DNA/RNA/protein registry entities, inventory containers and locations, ELN entries, workflow tasks, and Data Warehouse queries.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention benchling-sdk or the v2 API, or ask to automate lab data. Needs a Benchling account, tenant URL, and an API key or OAuth credentials.

say_en.text: Create a DNA sequence with benchling-sdk and register it in my registry.
